howItWorks.a:
AurionCal lets you sync your Aurion timetable to your Apple, Google, etc. calendar.

Your events are automatically updated to reflect changes on Aurion (about every hour). To do so, just create an account using your Aurion credentials, then subscribe to the generated calendar feed.

AurionCal is not affiliated with your school.

security.a:
To connect to Aurion and retrieve your data, AurionCal uses your Aurion credentials.

These are stored encrypted with a private key stored on an external service.

AurionCal source code is open and available on GitHub.

passwordChanged.q: I reset my Aurion password, what should I do?
passwordChanged.a: Login again with your new password. AurionCal will detect the change and update your data automatically.
